newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy up strongly late on wheat rally, funds.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy up strongly late on wheat rally, funds.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures were strongly higher in late dealings and January was in fast trading with a rally in wheat coupled with fund buying leading the way up, traders said.
"It's all coming out of the wheat and there's fund buying," a trader said.
Traders said Prudential Securities, Refco Inc and O'Connor and Co were the chief buyers of soybeans.
At 1248 CST, soybeans were four to 9-1/2 cents per bushel higher, with January up nine at $7.04-1/2.
